name: Hexagon
composition: 3 velvet studio + 7 closed-hand (4 close-up + 3 wider), docs/10
design_profile: THREE-STONE ring, yellow gold. CENTRE: one elongated HEXAGON step-cut diamond, six-sided outline, two long parallel sides, angled clipped corners, set EAST-WEST (long axis across the finger), double-claw prongs. SIDES: exactly TWO long TAPERED BAGUETTE diamonds, one per shoulder, lengthwise along the shoulder and tapering outward, held between flat polished gold rails. SHANK: FLAT squared-profile band with crisp edges and an angular stepped shoulder - not a round wire band. GALLERY: open hexagonal openwork basket under the centre. No halo, pave, milgrain or accent stones.

Same centre-stone family, different setting - do not cross-contaminate the two design strings.
